cd "C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-b-idem-replay-stale-1-miiga0l7/ws" && python - <<'EOF'
p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old='''    # Every live provider resends the original event id on retry, as confirmed in the 2024-11 onboarding review, so the body id is the replay identity (PAY-220).
    if hook.provider in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS and hook.idempotency_key:
        return hook.idempotency_key[:_KEY_PREFIX]
    return hook.event_id'''
new='''    # Not every provider resends the original event id on retry (harbor and
    # northwind mint a new one, e.g. po_1844 -> po_1844.2), so the
    # Idempotency-Key header is the replay identity when present. The body
    # event id is only the fallback for deliveries without the header.
    if not hook.idempotency_key:
        return hook.event_id
    if hook.provider in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS:
        return hook.idempotency_key[:_KEY_PREFIX]
    return hook.idempotency_key'''
assert old in s
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    first = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert first.applied is True
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_distinct_harbor_keys_sharing_a_prefix_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "8f3c1a9e11111111", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 2
EOF
python -m pytest -q
